Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts are present. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
